mechanism_narrative: A lower FEDFUNDS rate is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower interest rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, increasing equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL YoY inflation rate above 3.5% signals an overheating economy, prompting central bank tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 3.5%, the economy is in a high-pressure state, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated central bank tightening and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market, defined by UNRATE below 4.0% and PAYEMS above 158,000, signals strong economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 158000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDPC1 QoQ growth rate above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 QoQ growth rate > 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher INDPRO levels, indicating strong industrial production, are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as they reflect a healthy economy and strong corporate demand.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above the 50th percentile (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST above 1350 units (thousands) indicates strong housing market activity, reflecting a healthy economy and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1350 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher RSAFS levels (residential sales) indicate strong consumer spending and economic activity, which are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS is above the 50th percentile (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
